name: sdk-sample-ts
description: The obstack-js sample — two lines of setup produce the four-layer trace
//: Not a workspace member (D76): demo/ stays outside the product build, exactly like demo/agent-app. That is also why the versions below are exact rather than ranges — a sample app is an app, and an app that resolves a different provider version tomorrow stops being evidence of anything.
//dependencies: obstack-js comes from the tarball `npm pack packages/obstack-js` produces (D79) — the packaged artifact, so `files`/`exports`/types are exercised the way a customer would hit them rather than short-circuited by a workspace symlink; see README. openai 7.4.0: the real client the SDK's instrumentation patches, inside the supported >=4.85 <8 range. ai 6.0.256: the Vercel AI SDK version obstack-js's translation processor is pinned against — 7 emits no OpenTelemetry span at all, which is why this is exact and never `latest`. @ai-sdk/openai 3.0.97: the `ai`-6 line of the OpenAI provider (same @ai-sdk/provider 3.0.15 as ai 6.0.256), used only to point `generateText` at this app's own fake endpoint.
//devDependencies: The compiler and the Node types, at the versions the rest of the repo already resolves. No test framework: this sample IS the test — its evidence is the trace it lands in ClickHouse.
